comparison_ledger.incumbent_local_function: Iterate through candidate receptacles following the listed order, navigating to each, opening if closed, inspecting contents, and taking the target object when found.
comparison_ledger.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is not immediately visible and the room contains both open surfaces and closed storage receptacles

established_memories.guidance: When the target object is not immediately visible, prioritize navigating to and inspecting available open horizontal surfaces (e.g., countertops, shelves) before attempting to open closed storage receptacles (e.g., cabinets, drawers, fridge). For food items requiring downstream heating or cooling, optionally check food-preparation appliances (e.g., microwave, toaster) early if they are nearby, but do not exhaustively search all appliances before checking open surfaces, as food targets frequently spawn on countertops. Stop searching as soon as the target is observed and take it.
established_memories.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is not immediately visible in the entry observation and the room contains both open surfaces and closed storage receptacles. For food items, includes optional early appliance checks without delaying open-surface inspection.

established_memories.guidance: After acquiring the target object, locate a sinkbasin, navigate to it, and clean the carried object using an available sinkbasin. Then carry the clean object to the requested destination and place it.
established_memories.scope: ALFWorld tasks requiring cleaning an object before final placement.

established_memories.guidance: After acquiring the target object, navigate to a microwave, open it if closed, put the object inside, close it, and execute heating. Then retrieve the heated object and place it on the final receptacle.
established_memories.scope: ALFWorld tasks requiring heating an object before final placement.

established_memories.guidance: After acquiring the target object, navigate to a fridge, open it if closed, place the object inside to cool it, then retrieve it and transport it to the destination.
established_memories.scope: ALFWorld tasks requiring cooling an object before final placement.
